target.statement: Text-image CLIP similarity of 0.7676 for the proposed method (Ours) in the quantitative comparison
target.dataset: 5 stories, 35 prompts, 20 samples per prompt (700 generated images)

compute.basis: The target requires the full multi-component system (S2P with GPT-4, T2L trained on Object365, C-T2I based on Stable Diffusion with LoRA personalization, and I2V), generating 700 images with 50-step DDIM sampling; no code or data is released, and the pipeline depends on GPT-4 and large-scale training.

blockers: No code or model weights released (only a project page link)
Requires GPT-4 API for S2P component
Requires training T2L on Object365 (2M images, 30M boxes)
Requires training C-T2I on Flickr30k and fine-tuning Stable Diffusion
Requires training personalized LoRA weights for each character
Generating 700 images with diffusion models is computationally heavy and impractical on CPU
title: TaleCrafter: Interactive Story Visualization with Multiple Characters
